prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create exactly ONE production map building sprite for tianshu default Qing north kit, early-to-mid Qing northern China. Warm-neutral historic realism with finely modeled small gray roof tiles, weathered gray brick, dark brown timber, restrained natural palette, realistic construction, softly hand-finished rendering; NOT cartoon or low-poly. Orthographic camera yaw45 elevation30; strict2:1 dimetric ground, east projects down-right slope+0.5 and north up-right slope-0.5, parallel edges never converge. Vertical posts upright. Front/south entrance faces SCREEN LOWER LEFT. Entire structure on a very thin flat rectangular contact footprint with clear left/front/right ground corners. No thick plinth. True transparent RGBA background with NO surrounding color/gray/white/black backdrop, NO atmospheric glow/halo/haze. All roof tips and base corners contained, generous15% fully transparent margin. Screen upper-left light; only tiny contact shadow to lower right, no wide drop shadow. No people, text, signs, logos, writing, modern objects, scenic background, outside trees, street scene, checkerboard or exaggerated upturned eaves. 2:1 describes projection not canvas aspect. Original game building interpretation, not a named monument. Asset bld_kit_qing_north_pagoda. Footprint7m east-west x7m north-south, both ground axes equal length. A single modest five-tier northern Han Chinese solid gray-brick Buddhist pagoda, octagonal tapering masonry shaft, corbelled brick eaves on each tier, simple stone finial, narrow blind niches with no inscriptions, no wood pavilion stacked roofs. Small thin square stone footing. An original Qing-period city landmark, not a claim to reconstruct a particular historic tower. NOT a Tibetan white stupa, not an Islamic minaret. Keep entire tall silhouette intact. Square ground footprint foreground edges slopes+0.5 and-0.5 with equal screen horizontal runs. On1024x1536 canvas foundation LEFT(180,1170), FRONT(512,1336), RIGHT(844,1170). Tower extends vertically upward, no ground foreshortening distortion. EXTRA: absolutely NO ambient halo/glow/backdrop floor; uniform flat alpha0 outside the subject silhouette.
